scene:
Three areas side by side, read left to right. Do not write any title or heading above any area.

On the left, top: a dispatcher at a desk facing a blank computer screen, a wall clock beside her showing six o'clock, and two small vans waiting through the window; one label beneath this scene: 6AM: DISPATCH DOWN. On the left, bottom: a single card holding two icons side by side, a stopwatch labelled 4 HOURS and a small circular rewind arrow labelled 15 MINUTES.

In the centre: one horizontal timeline arrow running left to right with three stations in this order.
Station one, on the left: a large hourglass with a navy cross beside it, labelled DAY 45: 11 HOURS. Hanging below station one, three small obstacle icons in a row: a key with a question mark, labelled LOST KEY; a dusty old computer tower, labelled OLD DATABASE; a crescent moon over a data cylinder, labelled NIGHT-OLD DATA.
Station two, in the middle: a wrench crossed with a small coin, labelled FIX €20K.
Station three, on the right: a stopwatch with a large ochre check mark, labelled DAY 85: PASSED.

On the right, two cards stacked. Upper card: a map outline of a region drawn with a dashed border and a small umbrella with a hole above it, labelled WHOLE REGION NOT COVERED. Lower card: a wall calendar with four marked squares and a circular repeat arrow, labelled QUARTERLY RETEST.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: 6AM: DISPATCH DOWN, 4 HOURS, 15 MINUTES, DAY 45: 11 HOURS, LOST KEY, OLD DATABASE, NIGHT-OLD DATA, FIX €20K, DAY 85: PASSED, WHOLE REGION NOT COVERED, QUARTERLY RETEST. No headings or titles of any kind, no numbers on the clock face or calendar, no writing on the screen. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A dispatcher at a blank screen at 6am beside waiting vans, and a recovery objective of four hours and fifteen minutes; a timeline where the day-45 test takes eleven hours, blocked by a lost key and an old database and returning night-old data, then a €20K fix and a day-85 retest that passes; a card marking the whole region as still exposed and a calendar for a quarterly retest.
caption: From the objective a dispatcher would recognise, through a failed restore and a funded fix, to a passed retest and the risk still accepted on purpose.
